title: Philip Corso sees a Roswell body at Fort Riley

tellings.quote: opened up with the caskets and he saw the body from the Roswell.

plain: In 1947 at Fort Riley, Kansas, a man named Philip J. Corso is said to have opened caskets and seen a body from Roswell, the reported crash of an unknown craft in New Mexico that year. James Fox relays this to Michels from what Corso said, and credits Corso's own book The Day After Roswell, published in 1997. If true, it would mean bodies from the crash were moved through an Army base and seen by a soldier there.
